value0._comment: ZED2i HD1080 rectified stereo. Intrinsics/baseline confirmed from two independent sources: dataset manifest.json camera_info AND the ZED factory calibration for this unit (/usr/local/zed/settings/SN30291010.conf, Baseline=119.844mm). Images are pre-rectified (distortion all zeros).
value0._comment_extrinsic: T_imu_cam cam0 set to identity: the ZED2i factory camera_imu_transform (queried from firmware, SN30291010) is only 0.675 deg / 23.1 mm from identity, i.e. the IMU is effectively co-located with the left camera. Same assumption used for rosariov2 (also a ZED). VERIFY EMPIRICALLY (gyro-vs-VO Kabsch) before trusting for VIO.
value0._comment_noise: Common ZED field profile: effective measurement densities from the benchmark recording (gyro 0.0195 rad/s/sqrtHz, accel 0.180 m/s^2/sqrtHz); factory bias random walks with gyro converted from 0.0424 deg/s^2/sqrtHz to 0.0007400196 rad/s^2/sqrtHz. Derived without trajectory-error feedback; see docs/okvis-imu-noise-derivation.md.
